items.title: What is a GUI? Why is it important? (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of What is a GUI? Why is it important? (PDF 50, printed 46), paragraph for paragraph with the English; Code Explanation boxes and runnable examples added 2026-10-29.

blocks.text: GUI (Graphical User Interface) aik visual interface hai jis mein user buttons, menus aur forms jaisi cheezon se software chalata hai. GUI is liye zaroori hai ke yeh programs ko samajhna aur chalana aasan banata hai, khaas taur par un logon ke liye jo takneeki maahir nahi (non-technical users). Yeh screen par fauran nateeja dikha kar (visual feedback) aur mushkil commands yaad rakhne ki zaroorat kam kar ke istemal (usability) behtar karta hai. GUI applications desktop software, web applications aur mobile apps mein aam hain.

blocks.prompt: Command-line ke muqable mein GUI aik aam (non-technical) user ke liye kyun aasan hai?
blocks.explanation: GUI mein buttons, menus aur forms nazar aate hain aur fauran nateeja (visual feedback) dikhta hai, is liye mushkil commands yaad nahi rakhni parti.

items: GUI: buttons, menus aur forms wala visual interface.
Fayda: aasan istemal, visual feedback, commands yaad rakhne ki zaroorat kam.
